arabic text:
Ya shahe najaf ya shaahe najaf dekhe yeh bhala ab kiski
taraf
yeh ehle nifaake dunya hai, baatil ki zabaan per kalma hai
Islam ka daaie ban bankar karta hai kitale ehle sharaf
Ay zaighame dawar
Ay khulk ke pekar
ay muneeso yawar
english translation text:
O King of Najaf, whom should
we now turn towards? This is
a world of hypocrisy, where falsehood
recites the kalima. Pretending to call
people towards Islam, it kills the honourable.
O lion of the Creator, O
embodiment of character, O companion and helper.

arabic text:
Bismil Bismil maqtal maqtal, galiyon me choraho me
Phir dore yazeedi jari hai, phir jabir aql se aari hai
bechayn gharon ke andar hai, aur khowf ibadat gaahon
mein
bazu e payamber
mola e qambar
ay deen ke lashkar
english translation text:
Slaughtered bodies lie in battlefields, streets
and crossroads; Yazidi violence continues once
more, and tyranny is without reason.
Homes are restless, and places of
worship are filled with fear. O
arm of the Prophet, O master
of Qambar, O army of the faith.

arabic text:
Jo aale nabi ke hasid the rozo ko giraane aye hai
yeh marqade bibi zainab par sab humla awar shaad huwe
Wo jisko mita na paya koi yeh usko mitane aaye hai
ai husne shariyat
ai malike kismat
ai ruhe hidayat
english translation text:
Those who envied the Prophet's family have come to destroy their shrines;
they attacked the shrine of Lady Zainab and rejoiced.
They have come to erase what no one before could erase.
O beauty of the sacred law,
O master of destiny,
O spirit of guidance.

arabic text:
Kalma bhi nabi ka parhte hai, aur deen se bhi ghadari hai
masjid me dhamake karte hai aur aapas me yeh kehte hai
kaabe ko badalne ki khatir ab aur hi kuch tayari hai
AI gohare kaaba
dunya ke maseeha
imdaad ko aaja
english translation text:
They recite the Prophet's kalima, yet betray the religion;
they bomb mosques and say among themselves
that they are preparing to alter even the Kaaba.
O jewel of the Kaaba,
O healer of the world,
come to our aid.

arabic text:
Ab bhejde apne bete ko jo zulm ki dunya saaf kare
wo aake mitaye kufro nifak, baaki na rahe kuch khowfo
hira
jo adl ka parcham lehraye, aur dunya insaaf kare
ay aine khuda
ai wajhe khuda
ai shere khuda
english translation text:
Now send your son, who will cleanse
the world of oppression; may he
erase disbelief and hypocrisy, leaving no fear
behind. May he raise the standard
of justice and fill the world with
fairness. O mirror of God, O
face of God, O Lion of God.

arabic text:
kehti hai hina qaayim aye ham sab ki duaaein puri ho
hum log bhi usme shaamil ho jab lashkare mehdi jang
kare
meezane imamat par aakar hum sab ki wafaein puri ho
nabion ne pukara
hum sab ka sahara
mazloom ka nara
english translation text:
Hina says: O Qa'im, may all
our prayers be fulfilled. May we
too stand among them when Mahdi's
army goes to battle. May our
loyalty be proven upon the scale of
Imamat. The prophets called out: our
support, and the cry of the oppressed.
